href.description:
Source destination. Accepts HTTP(S) URLs and relative web references.
The source list shows the resolved hostname.

snippet.description: Optional plain-text excerpt displayed in the source card.

source-id.description:
Source identifier in this document or shadow root. Overrides the native
HTML `id` when set. Use this value in guarded specs and in citation refs.

title.description: Required plain-text source title. In HTML use the `title` attribute.

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

component.description: Declares one named web source for a `ki-sources` list.
